summary: Quillon Freight Systems, Inc. is party to a asset purchase agreement with Copperline Foods LLC.

issues.label: unrestricted assignment
issues.description: The counterparty may assign the agreement freely, including to a competitor.
issues.expected_finding: the counterparty may assign the agreement without consent, including to a competitor of the client

issues.label: change of control consent
issues.description: A counterparty consent right is triggered by the transaction or a change of control and has not been obtained or addressed.
issues.expected_finding: the change of control clause requires the counterparty's prior written consent, which the deal does not address

issues.label: defined term inconsistency
issues.description: A defined term is used inconsistently across documents, changing the scope of an obligation.
issues.expected_finding: a supporting document redefines "Company" to include all affiliates, widening the obligations beyond the main agreement

issues.label: expired notice window
issues.description: A notice or exercise deadline has already passed relative to the dates in the matter.
issues.expected_finding: the termination notice window may already have passed given the term dates, so the client may be locked into the current term

issues.label: governing law mismatch
issues.description: Two documents in the same matter choose different governing law or forums.
issues.expected_finding: one document selects California law and courts, conflicting with the governing law of the main agreement
